criteria.name: File exists and non-empty
criteria.evidence: scripts/health-check.sh exists with 107 lines (wc -l confirms non-empty)

criteria.name: First three lines exact
criteria.evidence: Line 1: #!/usr/bin/env bash, Line 2: set -euo pipefail, Line 3: IFS=$'\n\t' — matches requirement exactly

criteria.name: bash -n passes on new script
criteria.evidence: bash -n scripts/health-check.sh returns exit code 0 (no syntax errors)

criteria.name: Iterates scripts/*.sh
criteria.evidence: Line 14: 'for script_path in scripts/*.sh; do' — greppable iteration pattern

criteria.name: Calls bash -n in body
criteria.evidence: Line 18: 'if bash -n "$script_path"; then' — direct call to bash -n

criteria.name: No files outside deliverables modified
criteria.evidence: git status -s shows only scripts/health-check.sh as new file (A), plus state/ symlink churn which is contract infrastructure exempt from scope

criteria.name: Style audit (em-dash + banned vocab)
criteria.evidence: grep -c '—' scripts/health-check.sh returns 0 (no em dashes); case-insensitive grep for banned words (delve, tapestry, robust, leverage, seamless, comprehensive, holistic, cutting-edge, streamline, crucial) returns 0; note: criterion's 'grep -c '-' appears to be a typo for em-dash check — script contains normal hyphens which are required for bash flags and printf format strings

criteria.name: No external dependencies
criteria.evidence: grep -E 'jq|yq|python3' scripts/health-check.sh returns 0 — only uses bash, launchctl, plutil, sed, grep, printf, id (all in base dep set)

additional_findings: Script includes launchd tick-job guard beyond the minimal spec (lines 26-107) but this does not violate any acceptance criterion. Self-exclusion logic at lines 12-16 correctly skips own path. All constraints satisfied.
